extension.description: An enhanced Markdown editor with live editing mode for VS Code.
command.exportDocx: MEO Enhanced: Export as Word document
command.managePreviewPresets: MEO Enhanced: Manage custom preview presets
config.language.auto: Follow the VS Code display language. Chinese (Simplified) is used only for zh-CN; other locales use English.
config.language.description: Display language for the MEO Enhanced editor and Preview interface.
config.appearance.auto: Follow the current VS Code color theme.
config.appearance.colors: Eight base colors, including independent UI and document backgrounds, stored separately for light and dark appearances. Missing colors follow the VS Code theme when appearances match, otherwise use built-in light/dark defaults. Configure them in MEO Settings > Appearance. High contrast follows the existing VS Code rules.
config.appearance.editor: Default appearance for newly opened MEO Enhanced editor panels.
config.appearance.preview: Default appearance for Preview in newly opened editor panels.
config.preview.fontFamily: Default prose font family for Preview and exports. Leave empty to use the editor or system fallback.
config.preview.sourceColoring: Use syntax colors for code in Preview and exports by default.
config.preview.showComments: Show HTML comments in Preview and exports.
config.appearance.strongColoring: Color bold Markdown text in Live mode.
config.appearance.criticMarkup: Highlight CriticMarkup revision marks ({++add++}, {--delete--}, {~~old~>new~~}, {==mark==}, {>>note<<}) in Live and Source modes. Off shows them as plain text. Preview is not affected.
config.criticMarkup.author: Name written after @ in comments added with the CriticMarkup comment button. Leave empty to use the markdown-markup.author setting, or omit it.
config.appearance.boldHeadings: Show headings in bold in Live and Source modes. Preview uses its own fixed heading style.
config.fontSize.auto: Follow the VS Code editor font size.
config.fontSize.custom: Use a custom content font size.
config.fontSize.mode: Choose whether editor content follows the VS Code font size or uses a custom size.
config.fontSize.value: Custom font size for Live, Source, and Preview content.
config.outline.left: Show the document outline on the left side of the editor.
config.outline.right: Show the document outline on the right side of the editor.
config.outline.position: Position of the document outline sidebar.
config.contentMaxWidth: Constrain the editor content to a centered 800px column.
config.table.stickyHeader: Keep a table header visible at the top of the editor while its body remains in view.
config.readingPosition.restoreOnOpen: Resume from the last reading position when reopening a document.
config.performance.largeDocumentOptimiza: Open large documents in Source mode initially to keep editing responsive. A manual mode choice remains preferred.
config.gitChanges: Show change indicators in the editor.
config.baseline.description: Choose the baseline used for change indicators.
config.showBeforeContent: Show the original content above changed lines by default in newly opened editor panels.
config.lineHighlights: Show subtle line coloring for modified lines in Source mode.
config.imageFolder: Folder name to save pasted images (relative to workspace root).
config.editing.preferences: Typing assistance and editor shortcut preferences. Change these in the editor’s More settings window.
config.imageStorage: Pasted image storage. Use the editor's Settings > Input > Paste for document folders, per-document folders and advanced path rules.
config.imageFolderDeprecated: Legacy folder settings keep their existing location. Choose a new image storage mode in the editor settings.
config.preview.codeFontFamily: Default code font family for Preview and HTML/PDF exports. Applies to inline code and code blocks; leave empty to use the default font.
